preconditions.description: The number of sets n is at least 1 and at most 10,000.
The rank k is at least 1 and at most 100.

postconditions.expression: output contains a single integer m
postconditions.description: The output must include the minimal possible m.

postconditions.expression: output contains n sets, each with 4 distinct integers
postconditions.description: The output must include n sets, each containing exactly 4 distinct integers.

postconditions.expression: all gcd(s_i, s_j) = k for all i != j
postconditions.description: Each set must have the greatest common divisor of all pairs equal to k.

postconditions.expression: all integers in the sets are between 1 and m
postconditions.description: All integers used in the sets must be between 1 and m, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: no integer is used in two different sets
postconditions.description: No integer can be used in more than one set.
